description: pipedream is Matt Bartos's Python model for one-dimensional hydraulic simulation, state estimation and control. Its SUPERLINK formulation solves Saint-Venant equations on linked drainage elements, with optional infiltration and experimental water-quality components. Inputs include junction and link tables, hydraulic properties and boundary flow or stage series; outputs are simulated depths, flows and internal hydraulic states. Geographic coverage, network extent and time steps are user-configured. Public source and worked examples are free under GPL-3.0. A limitation is that water-quality routines are experimental and hydraulic accuracy depends on network discretisation, boundary conditions and numerical settings. Real-time interfaces do not make an uncalibrated system an operational forecast. pipedream can support stormwater-control and flood-response simulations, complementary to Delft3D FM (model-delft3d-fm). The README explains model construction and cites the Environmental Modelling and Software paper. No drainage dataset, model archive or live-control system was accessed.
